> Extraction textuelle : les tableaux complexes et diagrammes vectoriels peuvent nécessiter le PDF source.

6.357 rsElementMustContainChild
Applies to RDL 2011/01
rsElementMustContainChild is a critical error that will occur when an element is a collection of
elements and it is invalid when it does not specify at least one child element.
